_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

beats.role: prove it — or fail to, which is the point

voltage.why: G says 'G is not provable' — if the system could prove it, it would be false; so it is true AND unprovable. The truth the edifice cannot reach: the crack in every formal wall the whole book has been building.
the provable is a PROPER subset of the true — statements fall into a gap that never closes. The uncomputable / unprovable = the queer irreducible: what is real but outside the reach of any rule.
R = {x : x not-in x}, is R in R? The set that breaks itself the instant it is defined — self-reference opens an edge in the formal ground; the rule that eats its own tail.

paraconsistency: hold A and not-A at once and the world does NOT end. Florensky's supralogic is the QFEP answer to the crisis — the limit is not catastrophe but habitat; contradiction as a place you can stand.

voltage.after: prove it — or fail to, which is the point
voltage.why: QFE = F − λE(S) + φΔE(S,t) assembled: the honest limit named as structure, not failure. Incompleteness is where the book was walking all along — every formal system has an outside, and φ>0 is the queer signature that values that outside.
